breaking_reconciliation.root_cause_note: 58 of Vimanam 62 breaking changes (49 response + 9 request) and 18 of oasdiff 20 breaking changes (9 enum-removed + 9 const-added) come from OpenAI commit 2a24dea refactoring single-value enum:["x"] to const:"x" (semantically equivalent in JSON Schema 2020-12); neither tool normalizes 1-element enum <-> const, and Vimanam classifies response enum removal as breaking while oasdiff classifies it as level-1 info. The remaining 2 real structural spend_limit anyOf changes emit 2 findings in oasdiff vs 4 element-wise findings in Vimanam.
